title: Sprint By Default
description:
Always sprint without holding a key. Press R to toggle on/off.

CRAZY FOR SWORD PVP
body:
🏃 Sprint By Default
Tired of constantly holding Sprint or double-tapping W just to move at full speed? Sprint By Default makes your character sprint automatically — always, every tick, from the moment you load in.

✨ Features
Instant auto-sprint — no setup, no config, just drop it in your mods folder
Smart sprint logic — respects vanilla rules: won't sprint while sneaking, eating/blocking, starving (≤6 hunger), or under Slowness
Toggle keybind — press R (rebindable) to turn auto-sprint on or off anytime
Action bar feedback — shows Auto Sprint: ON or Auto Sprint: OFF above your hotbar when toggled
Client-side only — no server required, works on any server
🎮 How to use
Install and launch — you're already sprinting. If you need to stop sprinting (e.g. for precision movement), press R to toggle it off. Press R again to turn it back on.

You can rebind the toggle key in Options → Controls → Keybinds under the Sprint By Default category.

📦 Requirements
Minecraft 26.1.2
Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
Fabric API 0.150.0+26.1.2
Java 25
